messages.subject: For Christopher Boerner | Global healthcare, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Bristol Myers Squibb Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Christopher Boerner, Board Chair and Chief Executive Officer.

Bristol Myers Squibb's global biopharma platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems, communities and major investment priorities. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, ESG and stakeholder execution might support BMS's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Bristol Myers Squibb.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
